verdict.rationale: Gmail has a documented RESTful API with human-readable reference pages and endpoint listings (e.g., POST users.messages.send), but no evidence shows a downloadable machine-readable spec such as OpenAPI or an equivalent discovery document. Probes of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths and llms.txt on developers.google.com all returned 404. Human-readable REST reference docs do not satisfy a machine-readable spec story.
